name: Side panel
summary: The assistant opens in a panel next to the page the user is viewing, so it can answer questions about the page or act on it while the page stays in view. Browsers with built-in assistants use it as their main interface.
how: User opens the panel from a toolbar button or keyboard shortcut
The current tab, and tabs the user mentions, are sent as context
Answers and task progress appear in the panel while the user keeps browsing
facts: Perplexity Comet (Assistant sidecar), Gemini in Chrome
Keeps the page in view, but the panel is narrow for long output
goodFor: Questions about the page in front of you
Multitasking while a task runs in another tab
watchOut: Page content sent as context can include private data
